title: Choose Sevilla360’s visual system
question: Compare the same premium resort experience across the homepage and dashboard, then lock the direction that feels most like Sevilla360.

options.label: Refined Editorial Luxury
options.thesis: The homepage’s warm editorial confidence becomes a disciplined system for every guest and staff screen.
options.viewport: The existing homepage composition remains intact while booking and dashboard surfaces inherit its type, restraint, and warmth.
options.risk: Requires careful density control so operational screens stay fast rather than decorative.

options.label: Modern Resort Minimal
options.lineage: contemporary tropical architecture and quiet boutique hotels
options.thesis: A bright architectural system makes space, alignment, and calm the primary luxury signals.
options.viewport: The homepage keeps its structure but becomes cleaner and more architectural; dashboards use crisp modular bands and restrained color.
options.risk: The cleaner expression may feel less romantic than the current homepage treatment.

options.label: Cinematic Tropical Premium
options.lineage: evening resort photography and garden-event cinematography
options.thesis: Deep botanical color and dramatic imagery turn Sevilla360 into an immersive destination without sacrificing task clarity.
options.viewport: The same homepage layout becomes richer and more atmospheric; dashboards translate the world into dark ink navigation and light work surfaces.
options.risk: The strongest personality and motion demand stricter accessibility and performance discipline.
